_about: How eval scores a run against the answer key. Faults listed here get an honest inconclusive from System 1's sensor rules, because a jam reads the same as a pad on a part's edge: a run is marked down only for calling them passed. An answer key fault can also say "expect": "inconclusive" itself. needs_an_object lists fault properties that only show with an object placed in the device: the robot can't pick, so a run handles them by not calling the part passed.
